_rules: One entry per YouTube video. Facts come from Bob's own descriptions and from corrections by Mackenzie and Bob; nothing is invented or inferred. 'made' says what is real and what was added, leading with the real. 'generic' marks the channel-wide line used where nothing more is known: it never says photograph or video. 'photo' is true only where a description or Bob/Mackenzie says the picture began as a photograph. 'footage' is true only where the picture itself is a recording (video); only then may a hook say 'I filmed this' or 'I recorded this'. 'fire' is true where a fire is in the picture: Mackenzie (Oct 10) says none of the fires were recorded, they are all AI-generated, so the caption always says so. 'season' holds a video until that season (plan.mjs HELD_SEASONS). 'sharedSound' means other people recorded some of the sound, so the first Reel does not use the intro that says Bob records the sounds himself. 'onSite' allows saying the sound was recorded at this place. 'posted' videos were already seen on Instagram once and go last. 'anon' places have no real name, so no place line. Hooks: 48 characters at most, no colons, true for the video, never the same pattern twice, never just listing the sounds the caption lists next, never the title read back to back.
